title: RATR-O: Ramona Anti-Trafficking and Recruitment-fraud Ontology, with Virtual Knowledge Graph observatory
description:
RATR-O is a domain ontology in OWL 2 QL for the detection of fraudulent job offers, labour-recruitment fraud, and human-trafficking recruitment patterns in Latin America, with particular attention to Mexico.

The repository ships the ontology in Turtle and in navigable HTML, an Ontop OBDA mapping and a W3C R2RML mapping over Ramona AI's operational Postgres schema, a Dockerised Virtual Knowledge Graph demonstrator, and a dataset pipeline that ingests the CTDC Global Synthetic Dataset v2025 (IOM) and a press observatory of Google-News-indexed Latin-American articles. The ontology aligns with four international frameworks: HUTRO (BioPortal), the UN Palermo Protocol Article 3 (2000), ICS-TIP (IOM and UNODC 2023), and UNODC GLOTIP.

Prepared for the Dialogue Residency at TU Wien, Institute of Logic and Computation, May to July 2026, under the framework of Xiao, Ding, Cogrel and Calvanese (2019).

v1.6.1 passes an independent-style rigorous audit with zero BLOCKER and zero SHOULD findings. Every claim is traceable to its source; every external URL verifies; every statistical claim is computed from committed data by a committed script.
